types.label: value.title
types.note: A document is a VIEW over cell-facts. Membership + order are NOT in the doc value — they live in `_doc/<docId>/<blockKey>` decorations (type `doc-order`, value {seq, fold}). The doc value holds only {id, title, summary}. The inline `blocks` array is a deprecated fallback the loader honours only when no `_doc/` decorations exist.

schema.title: string
schema.blocks: DEPRECATED — legacy inline array [{key, fold?}]; substrate-native docs order block-facts via _doc/<id>/<key> doc-order decorations instead

types.label: value.id
types.note: A document block: markdown + lit fences (```mermaid/json/csv/run/js/repl, [[wiki-links]]). Any fact can be a block; it is placed into a doc by a `_doc/` doc-order decoration, not by living inside the doc.

types.label: value.seq
types.note: Ordering decoration. Key `_doc/<docId>/<blockKey>`; places that block-fact in the doc at `seq` (fractional for insertion between neighbours). This is the substrate-native doc membership — a doc is the set of facts decorated for it.

schema.seq: number — narrative position (fractional, e.g. 2.25, allows insertion)
